svg.title: Pastry chef — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as pastry chef, wearing a chef jacket and a chef hat. Visible work cue: An angled piping bag points toward the rounded icing on a small fluted cupcake. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a chef hat.
